models.lmstudioContextMeaning: LM Studio context length is the total window: system prompt, chat history, user input, tool output, and model output all count toward it.
models.lmstudioConfigOrder: Recommended setup order: first choose LM Studio context length based on available VRAM, then reserve max_tokens for output, and finally set CoPaw max_input_length from the remaining budget.
models.lmstudioContextGuideline: Use CoPaw max_input_length as the input budget and reserve max_tokens for output. A practical rule is: context length >= max_input_length + max_tokens + safety margin.
models.lmstudioNotAutomatic: This is a configuration guideline, not automatic detection. CoPaw does not currently read LM Studio context length and compute max_input_length for you.
models.lmstudioFormula: CoPaw max_input_length <= LM Studio context length - max_tokens - safety margin
models.lmstudioInternalConstraintTitle: Internal constraint under current LM settings (no LM expansion)
models.lmstudioExpandResourceTitle: LM resource expansion suggestion based on current settings
models.lmstudioAdjustmentPath: To lower CoPaw max_input_length, go to Agent Config -> Context Management and update the Max Input Length field.
models.lmstudioRecommendedContextLength: Recommended minimum LM Studio context length
models.lmstudioNeedBothValues: Set both max_tokens and CoPaw max_input_length to compute
models.lmstudioImpactNote: If context length is smaller than this combined budget, CoPaw can still hit context overflow before auto-compaction fully helps. For more headroom, reduce max_tokens or lower CoPaw max_input_length.
